description: Backlink check. Use when a task needs to confirm that a page links to a site or URL: whether the link is there, whether it is followed (no nofollow, sponsored or ugc) and whether the linking page can be indexed, based on Google's published robots and link rules. Cost: 1 credit per call.

page_url.description: The public page that should carry the link.

target.description: The site or URL the link should point at.

name: links_verify
